title_zh: 吉林省农安县委原书记白松巍接受审查调查
title_en: Former Nong'an County Party Secretary Bai Songwei Under Disciplinary Investigation
summary_zh: 据吉林省纪委监委9月21日消息，吉林省农安县委原书记白松巍涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动向组织交代问题，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Bai Songwei, former Party secretary of Nong'an County in Jilin Province, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations, and has voluntarily reported his problems to the organization, the Jilin Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection said on Sept 21.
body_zh:
中新网9月21日电 据吉林省纪委监委消息：吉林省农安县委原书记白松巍涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动向组织交代问题，目前正接受吉林省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
